purpose: Dated addendum for public TEM and SAED sources. Public availability, source-audit completion, and external-validation readiness are intentionally separate states.

external_validation_requires: checksum-bound raw or demonstrably lossless files
immutable or source-bound sample and acquisition identity
verified non-use in target model development and selection
a frozen evaluation and reference protocol
independent labels for TEM segmentation or traceable center and reciprocal calibration for SAED
at least two independent samples or acquisitions

candidates.title: Raw data for: Solvothermal Synthesis and Antibiofilm Activity of Silver Nanoparticles (rAgNP-Et)
source_metadata_confirmed: The record describes original experimental outputs.
The deposited archive explicitly combines TEM and SAED data.
The repository exposes an archive-level MD5 checksum.
unresolved: archive member inventory and member checksums
raw detector versus rendered or exported image status
TEM image calibration and acquisition conditions
SAED acquisition mode, detector metadata, pattern center, and reciprocal calibration
candidates.tem_role: cross-material unlabeled source audit and ingestion diagnostic
candidates.saed_role: bounded static-SAED source-audit candidate, subject to acquisition-mode confirmation
candidates.next_action: Write and review a bounded member-selection and byte-budget plan before downloading the 1.4 GB archive; stop before analyzer execution if center, calibration, lineage, or independent labels are absent.

candidates.title: Electrodeposited CoFeNi MEA coating on a Cu substrate from chlorides solution with enhanced corrosion resistance
source_metadata_confirmed: RepOD version 1.0, file-level CC BY 4.0 licence, 12-file inventory, target MD5 values, and computed SHA-256 values were verified live.
Both ZIP archives passed integrity, CRC, safe-path, duplicate-path, and symlink checks.
Seven single-frame TIFF raster exports were inventoried: BF, DF, three SAED-named images, HRTEM, and HAADF-STEM.
No native microscopy container or rendered JPEG-like raster was present in the audited subset.
Embedded metadata were limited to basic raster fields.
unresolved: native detector files and raw-detector status
accelerating voltage, detector, camera length, and pixel geometry per pattern
independence of the three SAED-named members
candidates.tem_role: cross-material lossless-raster format and metadata diagnostic
candidates.saed_role: cross-material uncalibrated static-pattern candidate for metadata resolution only
prohibited_claims: phase, reflection, or zone-axis confirmation from analyzer output alone
candidates.next_action: Do not run performance evaluation or tune parameters. Seek native files, member-level sample/acquisition lineage, independent TEM labels, and traceable SAED center/calibration from the authors or use a task-matched independent cobalt-oxide source.

candidates.title: The microstructure and He+ ion irradiation behavior of novel low-activation W-Ta-Cr-V refractory high entropy alloy for nuclear applications
source_metadata_confirmed: The record explicitly states that the TEM folder contains raw TEM images and SAED patterns.
The source distinguishes as-deposited and He-irradiated conditions.
The record links two downloadable Zenodo archive records.
unresolved: detector and accelerating-voltage metadata per pattern
candidates.tem_role: cross-material irradiation-domain robustness source after inventory resolution
candidates.saed_role: materials-domain static-SAED candidate after file-inventory and calibration resolution
allowed_use: bounded archive audit after exact files are resolved
prohibited_claims: external validation before member-level lineage is established
candidates.next_action: Resolve the two linked record versions, pin exact files and checksums, and select a predeclared two-condition subset without viewing analyzer outputs.

candidates.title: NEMI workshop on (automatic) (S)TEM data collection and analysis 2026: datasets
source_metadata_confirmed: The record is a public collection of TEM/STEM datasets used for a 2026 workshop.
The source exposes native HyperSpy and zspy-style files.
The diffraction example is SPED rather than static selected-area diffraction.
candidates.saed_role: mode-shift diagnostic only; SPED must not be relabeled as static SAED
candidates.next_action: Use only if a concrete native-format interoperability gap is identified; do not download the 2.1 GB SPED file merely to expand the dataset list.

candidates.title: Electron Microscopy Public Image Archive
material_domain: primarily biological cryo-EM and volume electron microscopy
source_metadata_confirmed: EMPIAR is an established public archive for raw electron microscopy data.
Its stated purpose includes method development, validation, and machine-learning reuse.
unresolved: a task-matched inorganic nanoparticle TEM segmentation cohort
static SAED patterns with traceable reciprocal calibration
material, acquisition, and annotation comparability to the current target
candidates.tem_role: archive discovery source, not a selected target-domain cohort
candidates.saed_role: not selected for the current static materials-SAED task
allowed_use: archive-level discovery when a task-matched record is identified
prohibited_claims: that archive reputation alone establishes dataset comparability
external validation based on unrelated cryo-EM data
candidates.next_action: Do not bulk-collect EMPIAR data. Revisit only for a specifically identified record that satisfies the target contract.
